source: Didi et al., FLIP2, ICML 2026 Spotlight; official FLIP2 website and download asset
scientific_context: Bacillus subtilis alpha amylase variants are measured by stain-removal activity, a detergent-relevant enzyme-engineering endpoint.
source_partition: Official train and validation variants with zero or one mutation.
deployment_partition: Official test variants with more than one mutation.
optimization_endpoint: Best-so-far stain-removal activity AUC under three initial target observations and twelve additional reveals.
candidate_skill: Estimate shrunk per-mutation effects from completed low-order source measurements, sum exact supported effects for each higher-order target candidate, and blend the source rank with target-only GP-UCB under fixed decaying authority.

coverage_aware_gate.coverage_rescue_rule: A calibration route whose confidence interval crosses zero may authorize transfer only when its mean effect is positive, its exact-token coverage is at most 0.10, deployment exact-token coverage exceeds it by at least 0.75, and all deployment applicability thresholds pass. A negative calibration mean is never rescued.

evidence_constraint: Official test activity values are unavailable to the LLM, structural coverage computation, gate decision, skill selector, candidate sampler, and protocol author at freeze time.
public_target_adapter: The gate receives a public-sequence-only deployment adapter that stores zero as a placeholder objective and excludes measured activity metadata. Outcome-noninterference is tested by changing target values while holding sequences fixed.
development_history: The rule is motivated by the preregistered TrpB false-negative hold and must therefore be evaluated only on this previously unused family. TrpB outcomes cannot enter the Amylase confirmatory endpoint.
claim_boundary: This protocol can provide prospective finite-pool evidence for or against one coverage-aware routing rule on one external enzyme family. It is not a wet-lab discovery, a universal safety proof, or a population generalization estimate.
